page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores based on the Intel Xeon 8369B processor, operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 310.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.46 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and relies on network-attached storage, while providing a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in low-parameter large language model (LLM) inference. For a small 135M model, prompt processing reaches 9711.08 tokens per second and text generation achieves 456.51 tokens per second. For a medium 7B model, prompt processing performs at 2509.43 tokens per second and text generation at 90.44 tokens per second. The instance also exhibits strong performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 230.87 GB/sec, image processing, and CPU encryption tests. General CPU and memory benchmarks, such as stress-ng and PassMark, fall within the average tier.

From a resource density perspective, the instance offers a balanced allocation of CPU and memory alongside dedicated GPU acceleration, making it a qualitatively cost-effective choice for workloads requiring moderate GPU compute without the overhead of larger multi-GPU systems. However, the lack of local storage represents a tradeoff, requiring external storage configurations for data-heavy operations. This server is suited for workloads such as small-to-medium LLM inference, image processing, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and general-purpose GPU-accelerated applications.
